trigger: Chapter start. A dirt bike in the dust, mid-morning.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Day fifty. October. Last night dropped to thirty-nine. A two-stroke engine screams up the dead street. Wraith loses it.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Not a warning bark. A happy one. She knows that engine.]

nodes.speaker: wes
nodes.text: BRAITH! Big brother! You look terrible! I brought beef!

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Wes. Nineteen. Road dust in his eyebrows, a cooler bungeed to the back of a KTM. Seventy miles of empty highway.

nodes.speaker: wes
nodes.text: Dad sent me. Here. He wrote it on a feed receipt because he's Dad.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The letter: 'Ranch is fine. Hay for the winter. Ander Etcheverry's organizing the valley. Come home. Bring the girl. — R.'

nodes.speaker: wes
nodes.text: He won't say it, so I will. He's scared. He keeps the radio on all night.

choices.text: Stay with us. It's safer here.
Go home. Tell him we're okay.

nodes.speaker: wes
nodes.text: Sheep guy from Fallon. Basque. Talks like a preacher. He's got the farms working together. It's actually cool.

nodes.speaker: wes
nodes.text: They're calling it the Compact. Water, feed, trucks. Dad's like his right hand now.

choices.text: Stay with us. It's safer here.
Go home. Tell him we're okay.

nodes.speaker: wes
nodes.text: Here? In the city? With the gangs and the line? ...Okay. A week. For Carly's cooking. Not yours.

nodes.speaker: carly
nodes.text: I don't cook. I boil things. Welcome to the boiling house, Wes.

nodes.speaker: wes
nodes.text: Yeah. Okay. Write him something back. He'll read it like forty times.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You write four lines on the back of the feed receipt. It takes you twenty minutes.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The beef is real. For one night the house smells like the ranch.
